title: Great app but be careful
body: Used this for a year, very good app for tracking habits. Giving 2 stars because they either left an oversight in their code or actively try to scam people. They offer premium for significant discount for new users (full price around 43$), discounted to 7$ per year. That's great and I agree to pay this price for good app. However, when I clicked accept offer, apple payment confirmation popped up as usual with a price of 43$/year - their full price. Nice discount guys, pretty sure you tricked some people with this;) for the people reading this - double check the prices before purchasing premium
author: HidroZ
